name: Grand Hotel Les Trois Rois
insider_take: Where Napoleon once slept and royalty still roams - this riverside legend has been Basel's crown jewel since 1681.
whats_special: This historic palace sits directly on the Rhine River and has hosted everyone from Napoleon Bonaparte to Pablo Picasso. The hotel's Michelin-starred restaurant Cheval Blanc by Peter Knogl offers some of Switzerland's finest dining, while rooms feature hand-painted silk wallpapers and antique furnishings that whisper tales of three centuries.
pro_tip: Book a Rhine-facing room for sunrise views over the cathedral, and time your visit during Art Basel in June when the hotel becomes the unofficial headquarters for art collectors and dealers worldwide.
dont_miss: The hotel's private Rhine terrace for sunset cocktails, and take the short walk across Mittlere Brücke to explore Basel's medieval Old Town. The nearby Basel Minster cathedral offers panoramic city views, while the world-class Fondation Beyeler museum is just a 20-minute tram ride away.
pros: Historic luxury property with over 800 years of hospitality heritage
Prime Rhine River location with stunning waterfront views
Exceptional fine dining at Michelin-recognized Cheval Blanc restaurant
Impeccable personalized service and attention to detail
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
Historic building with traditional room configurations
